question: A Deployment named checkout-api runs 12 replicas behind an nginx Ingress and a ClusterIP Service. The image is a Node.js HTTP server that does not register a handler for SIGTERM. During every rolling update, roughly 30 seconds of intermittent HTTP 502 and 504 responses appear on in-flight and new requests, yet `kubectl rollout status` returns "successfully rolled out" and no pod shows a restart count. Walk through the exact sequence: what happens between the moment the pod receives SIGTERM and the moment the kubelet sends SIGKILL, how EndpointSlice removal propagates to nginx and to existing keep-alive connections, which window produces the 502s, and which combination of application SIGTERM handling, preStop hook, and terminationGracePeriodSeconds settings eliminates them without lengthening the visible rollout?
answer: Two termination paths run unsynchronized: the kubelet sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL after terminationGracePeriodSeconds, while EndpointSlice removal propagates asynchronously to nginx. An app that ignores SIGTERM keeps serving the whole grace period, so draining endpoints and stale keep-alive connections return 502. Fix: a SIGTERM handler that stops accepting then drains, a preStop sleep so removal lands first, and a grace period exceeding preStop plus drain. rollout status only counts replicas.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCALE_DOWN[Deployment controller scales down old ReplicaSet] --> DELETE_TS[Pod receives deletionTimestamp]

  DELETE_TS --> KUBELET[Kubelet begins graceful shutdown on the node]
  DELETE_TS --> SLICE[EndpointSlice controller marks endpoint terminating:true ready:false serving:false]

  KUBELET --> PRESTOP[Run preStop hook: sleep 10]
  PRESTOP --> SIGTERM[Send SIGTERM to container PID 1]
  SIGTERM --> GRACE[Wait terminationGracePeriodSeconds]
  GRACE -->|deadline hit| SIGKILL[SIGKILL - connections truncated immediately]

  SLICE --> PROPAGATE[Ingress and kube-proxy converge on new endpoint list]
  PROPAGATE --> PROPAGATED[New connections stop arriving - takes 1 to 5 seconds]

  subgraph FAILURE[Observed 502 and 504 window]
    SIGTERM --> NO_HANDLER[App has no SIGTERM handler or PID 1 is a shell wrapper]
    NO_HANDLER --> STILL_ACCEPTING[Pod keeps accepting traffic for the whole grace period]
    STILL_ACCEPTING --> ERRORS[Stale keep-alive sockets and terminating endpoints return 502]
    GRACE --> ERRORS
  end

  subgraph NORMAL[Correct shutdown ordering]
    PRESTOP2[preStop sleep 10] --> DRAINED[Endpoints removed before app stops accepting]
    DRAINED --> HANDLED[SIGTERM handler closes listener and drains in-flight requests]
    HANDLED --> CLEAN_EXIT[process exits 0 inside the 45s budget]
  end

  ERRORS --> ROLLOUT_OK[kubectl rollout status reports success - replica counts only]
